1	
2	#Switch Panes like in Vim
3	bind h select-pane -L
4	bind j select-pane -D
5	bind k select-pane -U
6	bind l select-pane -R
7	
8	
9	
10	# Scroll History
11	set -g history-limit 60000
12	
13	# Set Status bar
14	if-shell "command -v powerline-daemon >/dev/null 2>&1" 'run-shell "powerline-daemon -q"'
15	if-shell "command -v powerline-config >/dev/null 2>&1" 'run-shell "powerline-config tmux setup"'
16	
17	set-option -g default-terminal "screen-256color"
18	
19	# Increase Vim Responsiveness
20	set -sg escape-time 0
21	
22	# Set window notifications
23	setw -g monitor-activity on
24	set -g visual-activity on
25	
26	# Use vi mode
27	set -g mode-keys vi
28	set -g status-keys vi
29	#setw -g utf8 on
30	
31	# Use vi keys for navigation
32	set-window-option -g mode-keys vi
33	
34	# reattach-to-user-namespace no longer needed since tmux 2.6+ (handles namespace reattach natively)
35	
36	# reload config
37	bind r source-file ~/.tmux.conf \; display-message "Config reloaded..."
38	
39	# based on https://stackoverflow.com/a/40902312/1046584
40	run-shell "tmux setenv -g TMUX_VERSION $(tmux -V | cut -c 6-)"
41	
42	run-shell 'tmux setenv -g TMUX_VERSION $(tmux -V | \
43	                            sed -En "s/^tmux\s+(\S+\s+)?([.0-9]+).*/\2/p")'
44	
45	if-shell -b '[ "$(echo "$TMUX_VERSION < 2.1" | bc)" = 1 ]' " \
46	    set -g mouse-select-pane on; set -g mode-mouse on; \
47	    set -g mouse-resize-pane on; set -g mouse-select-window on; \
48	    set -g message-fg red; \
49	    set -g message-bg black; \
50	    set -g message-attr bright; \
51	    set -g window-status-bg default; \
52	    set -g window-status-fg default; \
53	    set -g window-status-current-attr bold; \
54	    set -g window-status-current-bg cyan; \
55	    set -g window-status-current-fg default; \
56	    set -g window-status-bell-fg red; \
57	    set -g window-status-bell-bg black; \
58	    set -g window-status-activity-fg white; \
59	    set -g window-status-activity-bg black"
60	
61	# In version 2.1 "mouse" replaced the previous 4 mouse options
62	if-shell -b '[ "$(echo "$TMUX_VERSION >= 2.1" | bc)" = 1 ]' \
63	  "set -g mouse on"
64	
65	# UTF8 is autodetected in 2.2 onwards, but errors if explicitly set
66	if-shell -b '[ "$(echo "$TMUX_VERSION < 2.2" | bc)" = 1 ]' \
67	  "set -g utf8 on; set -g status-utf8 on; set -g mouse-utf8 on"
68	
69	# bind-key syntax changed in 2.4 -- selection / copy / paste
70	if-shell -b '[ "$(echo "$TMUX_VERSION < 2.4" | bc)" = 1 ]' " \
